definitions.explanation: With great care, especially of thinking, looking or checking.
To an extreme or unusual degree, often in a guess about how serious something must be.

examples.japanese: よくよく⟦{考|かんが}えて→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: I decided after thinking it over very carefully.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧よくよく⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦サインして→サインする：09864_sainsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please read the contract very carefully before signing.
Looking very closely, I saw a small cat painted in the corner of the picture.

examples.japanese: よくよく⟦{運|うん}→運：02143_un⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{謝|あやま}る→謝る：01177_ayamaru⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、よくよく⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことだ。
examples.english: For him to apologize, it must be something serious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{普段|ふだん}→普段：00041_fudan⟧⟦{怒|おこ}らない→怒る：00876_okoru⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あんな→あんな：01574_anna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{怒|おこ}った→怒る：00876_okoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、よくよく⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧だろう。
examples.english: My mother never gets angry, so to get that angry she must have been really furious.

notes:
A doubled, stronger form of ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- よくよく⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: when you really think about it, on reflection
- よくよく⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: on a closer look
- よくよく⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと / よくよく⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧: something serious; a pressing reason

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧: well, carefully; often
- ⟦じっくり→じっくり：06252_jikkuri⟧: slowly and thoroughly (of thinking or looking)
